title: Appeal.
bodyText: A moving party may appeal within thirty days as a matter of right from an order denying, in whole or in part, a motion under section 634G-3(a).
bodyHtml: [§634G-8]  Appeal.  A moving party may appeal within thirty days as a matter of right from an order denying, in whole or in part, a motion under section 634G-3(a). [L 2022, c 96, pt of §2]
